title: The Room in a Glass Box
description:
Solve your way out of a meticulously crafted diorama in this unique escape room experience.

 

Manipulate the glass box with intuitive click-and-drag controls, examine objects up close, and gather essential items to overcome challenging puzzles. Your objective: find the key and break free!

A serene, concentration-inducing soundtrack accompanies your exploration, creating the perfect environment to solve puzzles and uncover the secrets within.

In case you get stuck while trying to solve a riddle, click the bulb button to get a hint that will help you solve the puzzle you're stuck on.

Hi there, Frank Eno's here, I have been creating escape room and puzzle games since 2020 under the name of  XSGames, doing all by myself: code, graphics, music, design, concept, etc.
description_short: Escape a captivating diorama! Rotate, zoom, and solve puzzles to find the key. Explore a miniature room and unlock its secrets!
